claim: Under alpha=1, phi=1/2, and generalized gain per structural-gap unit a=1/8, the first binary finite-sensing scope that can enter the stable oscillatory feedback region is 6 worlds and 5 queries.
logical_certificate: Every binary task with at most five represented worlds has inherited structural-gap ceiling at most one.
Every binary task with at most four declared queries has inherited structural-gap ceiling at most one.
The existing sharp bounded-arity witness at six worlds and five binary queries attains gap two exactly.
Gap one reaches only the real/complex boundary G=G_osc; gap two enters the stable complex-eigenpair regime.
scope: finite deterministic unit-cost binary sensing plus declared canonical local response geometry
novelty_boundary: No novelty claim for decision-tree extremal counting, integer threshold rounding, or the complex-eigenvalue criterion; the repository-specific contribution is their exact composition into a sharp dynamical reachability threshold.
